column1: Information received since the September meeting indicates continued labor-market strength and solid real activity despite hurricane-related disruptions; consistent with the rule-based view of modern monetary policy (Clarida, Galí, and Gertler), the Committee maintains an accommodative stance while inflation runs below 2% and longer-term expectations remain anchored. The gasoline-price bump is a relative-price shock and, given sticky core prices (Nakamura and Steinsson), is unlikely to change the medium-term inflation path; hence the FOMC’s emphasis on gradualism, forward guidance, and balance sheet normalization aligns with Goodfriend’s framework for policy implementation and interest-on-reserves systems. Overall tone is moderately positive on growth and employment, tempered by soft core inflation and low market-based inflation compensation. sentiment score = 0.55
